title: A proof of the Sun–Hou conjecture on circular orderings of finite fields with primitive adjacent sums
description: Unrefereed computer-assisted proof candidate. Inherits the known large-field and prime-field results, then closes the 728-field remainder using an exact sieved criterion for 675 orders and explicit verified Hamilton cycles for 53. Includes frozen certificates, explicit field moduli, exact criterion witnesses and a non-destructive replay route. Original cases are not all new; novelty is bounded by the finite closure. No formal verification, external peer review or independent external reproduction is claimed.
references: Sun, Z.-W. Some new problems in additive combinatorics. arXiv:1309.1679v9, Conjecture 3.5(i).
She, Y.-F. Hamiltonicity in graphs defined by primes and primitive elements. arXiv:2609.19114v1.
Cohen, Oliveira e Silva and Trudgian. On consecutive primitive elements in a finite field. doi:10.1112/blms/bdv018.
